sources: cpwshop campsiteDetails pages for the Rosa sites (301-347), parkID 50033, read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails, Rosa sites 301-347 (37 sites): every one is 'Full Hookup' with Water Hookup 'Y' and Sewer Hookup 'Y'; 35 list 'Electricity Hookup 50', sites 310 and 318 list 30; CPW camping page ('Rosa Campground offers full-hookup RV sites'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 37 full-hookup RV sites (301, 304-320, 329-347 since the park renumbered its sites on 2026-04-17), 29 pull-through and 8 back-in, listed for vehicles 45-55 ft; CPW also lists 8 walk-in tent sites in Rosa.

sites.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails for Rosa sites 301-347 (Maximum Vehicle Length 45/50/55, Driveway Entry) + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/navajo-state-park/navajo-state-park-camping-lodging ('Rosa Campground offers full-hookup RV sites with 8 walk in tent sites and a camper services building'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Push-button showers, flush toilets and a coin laundry in the Rosa camper services building, which closes September 16 to April 14 (vault toilets in winter).

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/navajo-state-park/navajo-state-park-camping-lodging ('Push-button showers located in Rosa, Carracas and Tiffany campgrounds'; 'Coin-operated laundry facilities at the Rosa Campground camper services building'; 'Flush toilets located at Rosa, Carracas, and Tiffany campgrounds'; 'From September 16 to April 14, camper services and small restroom buildings in all three developed campgrounds are closed'; 'Winter amenities: Vault toilets'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead; reservations cannot be made at the park. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Rosa sites take bookings through the winter (site 312 bookable every night sampled November-March). Display a vehicle pass.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/navajo-state-park/navajo-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Navajo State Park ... online at cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance ... Reservations cannot be made at the park'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period') + cpwshop campsiteDetails site 312 (siteID 4680) availability grids for 11/10/2026, 12/15/2026, 01/15/2027, 02/15/2027, 03/20/2027: every night available, read 2026-10-27

note: Full-hookup campground near the marina on Navajo Reservoir at Arboles. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + every Rosa site page: confirmed full hookups (water/sewer at every site), pull-throughs, 55-ft max, showers, laundry, reservable on cpwshop. Changed count 39 -> 37 (Rosa's own full-hookup sites after the 2026-04-17 renumbering; the 39 counted Tiffany's and Carracas's single full-hookup sites too). Added 50-amp electric (2 sites 30-amp), flush toilets, booking url/180 days/fcfs never/14-night max, booking season year-round (bookable through the winter). Season year-round left as stored (CPW states no campground dates; only Carracas is said to shut down in winter). Fees ($41 full hookup, 2027 June) left as recorded. Note trimmed to what no field holds.
